Incorporating long-window (prior-twenty-exposure) label-free interaction features—specifically author/video repeat counts and author-distance—into the Factorization Machine input space will improve within-user ranking GAUC and nDCG@5 by explicitly modeling recent interest diversity and recency, thereby complementing the existing hour-aware and session-aware features in the accepted ensemble.
